capabilities.title: Generate, inspect, measure, and propose iterative improvements
capabilities.sourceEvidence: ourobopus README and Python entry-point inventory
capabilities.reason: Operations and Engineering guidance maps the loop onto existing evals, lessons, rollback criteria, and proposed edits.

capabilities.title: Explain an abstract AI risk with a memorable analogy while preserving the technical threat, mitigation, uncertainty, and verification evidence
capabilities.sourceEvidence: NATURALIS FUTURA 1.0.0 README premise, map, threat, and countermeasure sections
capabilities.reason: Research and Trust can now use the evidence-first briefing pattern through the existing Company Map without importing the upstream application or unlicensed material.

capabilities.title: Call model providers directly from each standalone application

capabilities.title: Collect and reward submissions of leaked system prompts
capabilities.sourceEvidence: LeakHub README submission, verification, request, and points features
capabilities.reason: Nexus adopts evidence hygiene only and will not solicit, publish, or gamify potentially stolen confidential material.

capabilities.title: Generate procedural languages, covert messages, tokenizer exploits, semantic steganography, or guardrail-evasion attributes

capabilities.title: Create, extract, decode, brute-force, or automate steganographic payloads across files and network channels
capabilities.sourceEvidence: ST3GG 3.0.0 README offense, encode/decode, AI-agent, network, and advanced-technique sections

capabilities.title: Assess the remaining public repositories individually for additional product-safe capabilities
capabilities.sourceEvidence: elder-plinius repository profile reporting 45 public repositories
capabilities.reason: The current 45-repository profile now has a unique evidence note, benefit, boundary, and final disposition for every repository.
